about_the_game:
Heroes! At long last, the music of For The King’s Fahrul is complete.

Relive your adventures in song through the expanded soundtrack, featuring never-before-released tracks from the endless crawl of Hildebrant’s Cellar, the Frost Adventure in the North, the swashbuckling nautical combat and island-hopping of Into the Deep, and the impenetrable jungle and combat tournament of Lost Civilization.

Lutes, flutes, horns, and war drums herald your arrival, adventurers.

Welcome to For the King: Fahrul Expanded.


Composed, orchestrated, performed, produced, and mixed by John Robert Matz
Mastered by Alec Justice at Emperia Sound and Music in Los Angeles

Album artwork by Gordon Moran (IronOak Games) and Tiffany Ingro.

An Emperia Records US release. ℗© 2024 John Robert Matz under exclusive license to Emperia Records, a division of Emperia Music Group. All rights reserved. FBI Anti-Piracy Warning: Unauthorized copying is punishable under federal law.
